name: Odraz Monastery
description: Located at the southern foot of the Rainbow Dale mountains, on the extreme western edge of the Central Empire, Tamera’s devotees have maintained the Odraz monastery for centuries. Its alabaster walls are adorned with carvings of angels, saints, monks, and paladins. Those who attain the status of saints and heroes of the church may have statues carved here honoring them. Hundreds of monks and priests keep the monastery’s daily routine of prayer, study, and meditation, but what makes Odraz famous is its unique martial art—created centuries ago by Odraz’s traveling preachers who returned from distant lands, bringing back insights about Yama’s unique blend of meditation and physical training for self-improvement and fusing it with the Odraz paladins’ training. By combining physical exercises, combat training, weapon drills, meditation, and prayer, they have developed a unique style that blends faith, inner strength, weapon mastery, and hand-to-hand combat. Odraz primarily admits young recruits chosen through the meditative divination of Odraz masters. Other individuals wishing to learn from them must offer substantial donations and agree to perform services for Odraz, usually helping small communities and facing evil creatures as a test of their worth. Individuals may be accepted for training at Odraz if they approach the tasks with sincerity, dedication, and a genuine desire to assist those in need. Rumors suggest that the monastery houses a sacred torch, crafted by a saint and blessed by Tamera. This artifact would be the only one capable of completely illuminating areas within the Penumbral Plane. While the true origin or power of the artifact remains a mystery, the monks do their utmost to protect their secret vault from intruders.
